# Generated previews — do not edit

Both files here are **build output**, produced by:

```bash
npm run previews
```

They exist only so the experiences can be rendered in environments that cannot
resolve module imports. They are not source, and they are not an input to
development.

- `MetYetCollector.preview.jsx` — the Collector experience
- `MetYetPrototype.preview.jsx` — the full unified prototype (chooser, both
  personas, one shared store)

To change anything, edit the canonical modules under `src/`, `collector/`,
`shell/` and `domain/`, then regenerate.
